verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents API tokens that can be created and expired in the dashboard, which covers the API-key part of the story. There is no evidence of roles, RBAC, or tokens scoped per namespace. The permissions guide only describes storing user/group IDs on documents and filtering at query time. That is an application-level building block, not enforced access control, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: role-based access control, per-namespace/collection scoped permissions, key scoping (e.g. read-only vs write), and any independent corroboration.
